$comment: No $id on purpose: Test-Json resolves relative references only without an absolute $id, and every Rulebook schema follows the same rule.
title: Rulebook diagnostic catalog
description: catalog/diagnostics.json of an organization rulebook repository: every known diagnostic id with its analyzer default (D24). Minimal on purpose: the three fields the generator needs are required, the other known fields are typed, and the scan (WP08) may add more per entry. See docs/reference/naming.md.

diagnosticId.description: A diagnostic id: two or three capital letters, four digits, an optional lowercase i (PTE0011, AL0432, LC0089i).
